summary: Frontend-only iteration56 verification completed for TV/Desktop equalizer/sidebar geometry, D-pad semantics, shared sidebar navigation IDs, small-landscape overflow, and public /api/tv-app/ asset availability.

integration_issues.flow: Favorites >21 rows fixture validation (browser-only test harness)
integration_issues.issue: Could not materialize >21 favorites cards in this run; deterministic fixture injection path is not currently available from test harness context, so deep-row D-pad/scroll validation remained unverified.
Global player did not appear during this run (button-global-play-pause absent), so the required 925-top/24-gap assertions under active currentStation could not be fully validated.

action_items: Add/keep a deterministic non-production favorites fixture hook for web-preview test harness (so >21 favorites rows and deep D-pad scrolling can be regressed reliably without mutating user account).
Expose a stable testID on Discover scroll container (like genres-scroll-area/favorites-scroll-area) to make bottom-gap assertions deterministic.
Enable one deterministic path to establish currentStation in preview tests (or expose a read-only seed) so player-overlap gap rules can be verified under active player state.
Review FavoritesContext API base URL usage for env compliance (see code review comments).
critical_code_review_comments: Env violation: /app/frontend/tvanddesktop/apple-tv-and-macos/web-preview/src/contexts/FavoritesContext.tsx line 6 hardcodes API_BASE='https://api.themegaradio.com' instead of env-driven base URL.

Maintainability risk: /app/frontend/tvanddesktop/apple-tv-and-macos/web-preview/src/pages/DiscoverNoUser.tsx is very large (>1500 lines), and /src/pages/Settings.tsx is also very large (~1000 lines); split into smaller focused modules per guideline.
Testing reliability gap: Discover scroll container lacks dedicated data-testid unlike Genres/Favorites, making geometry regressions harder to automate robustly.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% of requested checks executed and passing; unresolved coverage on favorites>21 fixture and active-player bottom-gap scenario

seed_data_creation: None in backend/live account. FAVORITES fixture attempts were test-harness-only and did not mutate production account data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equalizer geometry measured at 1920x1080, 1280x720, 1366x768, 2560x1080, 3840x2160. No sidebar/preset overlap detected; elementFromPoint center/edges on Settings passed. D-pad semantics passed (up/down gain step, left/right band navigation, Enter-on-band => reset focus). Tiny 1280/1366 numeric deltas (73.999/235.999) are floating-point precision around exact 74/236 boundaries, not visual overlap. Shared sidebar IDs are unique across tested pages. /api/tv-app/ and linked JS/CSS returned HTTP 200. regression_issue54_behavior.cjs passed (41 assertions).
rca_of_issue: Primary unresolveds are testability/instrumentation related: (1) deterministic >21 favorites fixture path could not be activated from browser harness in this run, blocking deep-row favorites validation; (2) currentStation/player-bar visible state could not be deterministically established in tested flow, blocking full with-player bottom-gap assertions.
